description: Make a shareable invite page on Foundaree for an event, sale, opening, party or launch. The page shows a live countdown to the date, the place and message, and Coming / Maybe / Can't come buttons that guests tap without signing in. The user picks a design. Returns the link to share (WhatsApp, Instagram, anywhere). Use my_invites later to see who is coming.

design.description: The look of the page: classic (clean teal), midnight (dark and starry), sunset (warm orange and pink), garden (soft green, floral), confetti (bright and playful), royal (deep purple and gold, formal), minimal (black and white), neon (dark with glowing colours), birthday (balloons and bunting), wedding (ivory with a gold frame and leaves), festive (deep red and gold with lamps, for Diwali and other festivals), ticket (looks like an event ticket), poster (bold yellow and black, for a sale or launch), ocean (blue with moving waves), retro (70s sunburst), business (clean navy header, for a meeting or opening). Offer the user the choice; pick one that fits the occasion if they have no preference.

host_name.description: Who is inviting, as shown on the page.

rsvp_enabled.description: false for a countdown-only page with no reply buttons. Default true.

starts_at.description: The date and time with its time zone offset, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-12-01T17:00:00+05:30. Ask the user if the date or time is unclear.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone to show the time in, e.g. Asia/Kolkata. Defaults to Asia/Kolkata.

title.description: The event name, e.g. "Glow Salon grand opening".

name: create_invite
title: Make an invite page with a countdown
